decisions.rationale: 'periodontal disease' is a family term covering several periodontal conditions such as periodontitis and gingivitis, so it is a Disease Class rather than one specific disease.
'palmoplantar keratosis' names a single clinical condition that the paper treats as a feature of PLS, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
'Papillon-Lefevre syndrome' is a named specific disease with one definition.
'keratosis palmoplantaris with periodontopathia' is the alternative long-form name for the same specific disease (PLS), annotated as a separate mention with its full span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 - Synonymous mentions; 5 - Minimum necessary span

decisions.rationale: 'PLS' is the abbreviation defined in the text for Papillon-Lefevre syndrome and is annotated as a separate mention.
'autosomal recessive disorder' refers to a family of diseases inherited in an autosomal recessive manner, matching the autosomal recessive disease example.
'periodontitis' is a specific named periodontal disease with a single definition.
Duplicate mention of palmoplantar keratosis in a later sentence of the same abstract; duplicates are annotated separately.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 - Duplicate mentions; 1 - Specific Disease

decisions.rationale: 'hyperkeratosis' names a specific keratinizing skin disease condition that the paper treats as a disease component of PLS, as shown by its use in a composite mention; it is not a generic term.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; What NOT to Annotate 4 - General terms (not applied)

decisions.rationale: 'Keratosis' refers in context to the palmoplantar keratosis condition of PLS, so it is a disease mention rather than a generic use of the term.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; What NOT to Annotate 4 - General terms (considered)

decisions.rationale: 'PLS' is used as an adjective modifying 'patients' (Most PLS patients), so it functions as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease mention.
'periodontitis and hyperkeratosis' is a contiguous string containing two separate disease mentions and cannot be split without information loss.
'palmoplantar keratosis or periodontitis' is a contiguous string of two separate disease mentions joined by 'or'.
'periodontitis' is a specific disease mention referring to a single condition.
'PLS' modifies 'locus' (The PLS locus), functioning as an adjectival modifier, so it is a Modifier.
'PLS' modifies 'patients' (PLS patients) as an adjectival modifier, so it is a Modifier.
